topic: New antibiotic teaching (select all that apply)
voiceLine: New antibiotic prescription. Which of these do you teach? Select all that apply.

card.text: A. Take it exactly as prescribed
B. Don't share it with anyone
C. Save leftovers for next time
D. Stop once you feel better
E. Report rash or trouble breathing

answer: A, B and E. Saving leftovers (C) and stopping early (D) are unsafe; E covers allergic reaction and anaphylaxis.
